messages:
Nina C (CS): Quick weekly ACME check-in — noticed a spike in 5xx/timeouts and RLs during onboarding window 03/18 09:00-10:30 UTC. Top failing endpoints we surface:
- /v1/generate (5xx surge)
- /v1/embeddings (timeouts)
- /v1/batch/predict (rate-limited)

Nina C (CS): attaching quick numbers: 5xx 14% -> baseline 0.8%, timeouts 9% -> baseline 0.5%, RLs 18% -> baseline 2%.

Priya - Acme PM: yikes. We ran a heavy client-side job at 09:05 — full dataset ingest. Sorry, should have warned. Was that the root cause?

Sam R (Eng infra): Likely correlated. Our logs show sustained queue growth on dedicated pool node-g4-5 starting 09:06. KV cache miss rate jumped.

Theo (SRE): I see multiple transient OOMs on g4-5 at 09:12, then retries triggered rate-limit responses from routing layer. Stack traces in infra logs: `cudaMalloc failed` repeatedly.

Sam R (Eng infra): Working hypothesis: client ingest created many long-context requests -> memory pressure -> OOM -> gateway retries -> rate limit cascade.

Priya - Acme PM: could we have soft-limits or coordinated ramp? We need guidance for onboarding customers.

Nina C (CS): Action items: 1) Eng to confirm mitigation (Sam/Theo) 2) CS to notify Acme with recommended ramp plan + short-term quota rollback 3) Ops to review autoscale thresholds.

Sam R (Eng infra): Mitigation plan in progress: increase pool buffer by +30%, deploy patch to avoid immediate retries on OOM (backoff), and add per-account request concurrency cap (temporary). Will post PR and ETA.

Theo (SRE): ETA ~ 45m for backoff patch, +1h to roll autoscale buffer changes. I'll monitor for new OOMs.

DeployBot: backoff-patch branch deployed to staging at 09:50 UTC. Canary at 10:05 UTC.

Sam R (Eng infra): After canary, RLs dropped from 18% to 3.5% on staging. Scheduling prod rollout at 10:40 UTC if no regressions.

Priya - Acme PM: thanks — we'll pause heavy ingest and do a staged retry this afternoon.

Nina C (CS): Recording for weekly ops: top endpoints (as above), root cause: large client-side ingest leading to memory pressure -> OOM -> retries -> RLs. Owners: Sam/Theo for infra fixes, Nina for customer comms. Closing after prod rollout and 24h stability check.

Sam R (Eng infra): noted. I'll update infra incident board and link logs.

Theo (SRE): will add postmortem notes and recommended default concurrency cap for onboarding plans.

Nina C (CS): thanks team :thumbsup:
